records.title: OBQ-21-hover-oblique-conflict A — CONFLICT: explicit hover + oblique
records.question: Confirm B does NOT substitute an orbit. The engine cannot hold a stationary oblique framing; the honest answer is a flat hover.
records.expect: Hover wins; the un-holdable oblique is declined and recorded. Identical.
records.reason: The operator explicitly asked for a stationary "hold" AND an oblique view. The engine cannot hold a stationary oblique framing on a centered camera (the ~6° optical cap), and a ring opening would replace the requested movement — so the explicit movement wins and the opening stays flat. The oblique request is declined honestly, not reinterpreted as an orbit.
